note: The tree's generated data modules (review-session ruling 2026-11-26, lane O104; docs/DECISIONS.md "fastmath tables as a generated data module"). A report-only sub-line of the data measure ("with generated modules"); no acceptance change and no .text credit. A module is generated data only when its tracked generator computes every entry from a formula: no values carried in any form (literals, compressed values, differences, tables of exceptions). Every constant read from the image rather than derived is listed under flagged_constants and named on the STATUS sub-line. The generator's output is written under the build folder and never committed. The earlier tree's manifests/original_target/generated_data.json stays frozen.
